title: Bounded finite free internal Hom preserves all quasi-isomorphisms
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Let $E^\bullet$ be an integer cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-hom-complex] such that there are integers $M,N$ with $E^p$ zero for $p<M$ and for $p>N$, and for each integer $p$ there is a natural number $r_p$ and an isomorphism $E^p\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus r_p}$. For any quasi-isomorphism $s:G^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ of integer cochain complexes [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], the induced morphism
$$\mathcal Hom_X^\bullet(E^\bullet,s):\mathcal Hom_X^\bullet(E^\bullet,G^\bullet)\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom_X^\bullet(E^\bullet,I^\bullet)$$
is a quasi-isomorphism. Neither $G^\bullet$ nor $I^\bullet$ is required to be bounded or injective, and no derived category is assumed.

proof.text: Combine the separate lower bound M and upper bound N into the finite interval hypothesis: a degree outside [M,N] is zero by the corresponding given bound. This also handles reversed bounds.

For every degree p and short exact sequence S, choose the finite rank r and the isomorphism E.X p to the free rank-r sheaf from hfree. Apply finiteFreeInternalHomExact and retain its short-exactness conclusion; the additional finite-sum coordinate identifications are not needed.

Apply quasiIso_homComplex_map_of_bounded_exact_terms to the finite interval and termwise exactness just established. Its finite-width induction on the stupid source tail proves the conclusion for arbitrary target complexes, without a separate mapping-cone identification.

proof_origin.place: Finite source interval argument, using the existing bounded exact-term Hom induction and finite-free internal Hom exactness.

lean.statement:
theorem quasiIso_homComplex_map_of_bounded_finiteFree
    (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, N < p → IsZero (E.X p))
    (hbelow : ∃ M : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p < M → IsZero (E.X p))
    (hfree : ∀ p : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X p ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings X) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    {G I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ}
    (s : G ⟶ I) [QuasiIso s] :
    QuasiIso (((homComplexFunctor (R := X.sheaf)).obj (op E)).map s)
